content:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a cross-GPU attention benchmark this morning (A100 / H100 / L40S) comparing Flash variants + our fused-paged combo. Seeing a consistent H100 throughput dip around seq=2048, bsz=8. Posting notes + raw snippets.

aj: ack, thanks. which flash variant? v1/v2/paged? any kernel fallbacks in the logs? :thinking:

maria: tested flash_v1, flash_v2, paged, fused-paged (our fused layer + paged KV). flash_v2 and fused-paged look great on A100/L40S. H100 drops ~18-25% vs A100 at seq=2048, bsz=8. No obvious CUDA OOMs. Logs attached below.

kevin: hmm sounds like a kernel choice issue. Do you have the kernel selector trace? it should show why it picked scalar fallback or different tiling.

maria: pasted selector trace excerpt:
```
KERNEL_SELECTOR TRACE:
seq=2048, bsz=8 -> tried fused_paged_opt (est latency 9.8ms) -> selected flash_v2_tiled (est 7.2ms) -> executed flash_v2_tiled (actual 12.4ms)
fallbacks: none, but post-run hints: prefetch_miss=0.42, kv_spill_ratio=0.06
```

aj: the estimator predicted flash_v2_tiled faster but actual slower — estimator mismatch. Prefetch_miss 0.42 is high for H100? could be PCIe or NVLink congestion depending on box topology. Which instance type?

maria: test rigs: A100: 4xA100-SXM, H100: 4xH100-SXM, L40S: 4xL40S. All on same chassis, same driver stack (525.x), NCCL 2.18. Topology similar.

kevin: can you share the perf counters? memcpy, l2 hit, tensorcore utilization?

maria: snippet from perf profile (aggregated):
```
H100 seq2048 bsz8 fused-paged:
- tensor_core_util: 73%
- sm_efficiency: 64%
- l2_bandwidth_util: 41%
- pci_memcpy_stalls: 12%
- kernel_occupancy: 84%
```

sophia: tensor_core_util 73% but sm_eff 64% — might be warp divergence or sync stalls. pci_memcpy_stalls 12% is non-trivial for local cache hits. Do you see many small memcpys (KV shuffles)?

maria: yes mem profiling shows lots of small memcpy bursts at token emission boundaries. suspect our KV cache defragmenter or evictor causing scatter/gather.

aj: that would explain H100 being worse — H100's memory subsystem prefers larger contiguous transfers for tiled kernels. Fused-paged introduces more scatter for some layout shapes. Could the kernel chooser be prioritizing smaller tile sizes on H100 for that seq/bsz point?

kevin: also check our per-GPU page-fault/hotpage stats. If the allocator uses many small buffers for KV pages, we might get TLB pressure. H100 has different L2 behavior vs A100.

maria: good call. I grabbed the allocator stats: page-frags ~0.22, tlb-misses up ~3x vs A100 at same workload.

sophia: try two quick experiments: 1) force batch_split=2 (reduce per-kernel dynamic tiling), 2) disable paged prefetch for H100 run. If perf recovers, we have a prefetch alignment problem.

maria: running both now. command:
```
./bench_runner --model=gpt2-xl --kernels="fused-paged,flash_v2" --gpus=h100 --seqs=512,1024,2048,4096 --bsz=1,4,8 --batch_split=2 --prefetch=off --iters=50
```

perf-bot: CI bench job created: https://ci.redwood/bench/2487654321 (logs will land in ~15m) :eyes:

kevin: if disabling prefetch helps, we should add a quick kernel selector rule: prefer flash_v2_tiled on H100 for seq >= 1024 unless prefetch alignment > 0.6 and page-frags < 0.1. (rough rule)

aj: agree but let's capture a proper feature vector for the estimator: {seq_len, batch_size, avg_prefix_hit_rate, page_frag_ratio, avg_kv_size, prefetch_miss_rate, gpu_model}. We can retrain estimator quickly with existing traces.

maria: current quick-run results (first pass):
- fused-paged H100 seq=2048 bsz=8 baseline: 12.4ms/token
- fused-paged H100 seq=2048 bsz=8 batch_split=2: 9.6ms/token
- fused-paged H100 seq=2048 bsz=8 prefetch=off: 9.9ms/token
- flash_v2 H100 seq=2048 bsz=8: 8.1ms/token

sophia: batch_split helped a lot — suggests per-kernel occupancy vs memory transfer balance was off. Good repro.

kevin: nice. Can you rerun with kernel selector logging enabled and collect the estimator inputs/outputs for those runs? We want to know exactly which features pushed the choice.

maria: will do. Also adding a small microbench for memcpy shapes to correlate with memcopy stalls.

aj: long-term: add a quick hardware-profile hook into the estimator that infers per-GPU preferred transfer size and penalizes kernels that cause lots of small scatters on H100.

maria: agreed. For now I'll push a canary rule: for H100, if seq >= 1024 and page_frag_ratio > 0.15, prefer flash_v2. Will open a small PR for kernel selector heuristics and attach the runs.

perf-bot: linked PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/kernel-selector/pulls/112 (canary heuristics + tests)

kevin: once PR lands, let's schedule a larger sweep across random prefix distributions to ensure we didn't overfit to this sample.

maria: plan: full sweep across seq={512..8192}, bsz={1,2,4,8}, prefix-hit-rate={0.1,0.5,0.9} on H100 and A100. I'll shard jobs across 8 runners. ETA tomorrow EOD.

sophia: ping me when jobs start, I'll help with collection + analysis scripts.

maria: thanks all — will post summary csv + heatmap once sweep completes. :thumbsup:
